source.title: Prospecting Adamantite Ore yields too many uncommon gems (ChromieCraft private-server reproduction)
source.author: ghost

notes: First-person ChromieCraft/AzerothCore-WotLK EMULATOR regression after AzerothCore PR #14456; phase 61-64 (enUS), not official Blizzard Retail/TBC loot and explicitly reports incorrect uncommon-gem behavior. Source states 1,000 Adamantite Ore spent, but no verified per-operation event log/refund reconciliation; 200 five-ore equivalents are nominal only and casts stays null. This is quarantined reference evidence for contrasting anomalous private-server output, never an independent Blizzard drop study or live predictor. Quantities pooled by quality tier, not individual output material IDs; per-gem positive-hit counts, zero outcomes, and event histograms are unknown. Distinct from Diary of a Guild Leader/Frostadamus transcriptions and other prior Adamantite studies.
outputName: Any rare-quality Outland gem (pooled tier, IDs unknown; emulator regression)
